A service that is already running reads it only at its next start: stop it once (Ctrl+C on deckent runtime serve; a service the terminal started also stops by itself after its idle time, 15 minutes by default), then deckent runtime restart and deckent runtime shutdown work.

cli.init.policyUpgrade.serviceIdentityOt: service.identity names scope {scope} (service {service}), not this scope; it was kept as it is. deckent runtime restart stops that service only with a shutdown grant in {scope}.
